info.title: dotcl
info.description: Common Lisp on .NET; compiles CL to CIL and runs via .NET JIT

commands.name: build
commands.description: Compile an ASDF system to a fasl

commands.name: clean
commands.description:
Remove dotcl's caches: the shared ASDF compile
cache (one directory per dotcl build under
<cache-home>/common-lisp/) and the JIT startup
profiles (<cache-home>/dotcl/jit/). A project's
own obj/ cache goes with `dotnet clean`
[--dry-run] [--verbose]
[--keep-current: compile cache only]

commands.name: pack
commands.description:
Package an ASDF system as a dotnet tool nupkg,
built by restamping the published dotcl tool
packages in --from
(--id <pkgid> --command <cmd>
-o <dir> --from <dir>
[--version <ver>; default: the .asd's]
[--dotcl-version <ver>]
[--toplevel <fn>] [--bundle <dir>]
[--prelude <file>] [--rids <csv>] [--r2r]
[--dry-run]
[--description <text>] [--project-url <url>]
[--repository <url[#commit]>] [--readme <file>]
[--tags <csv>] [--authors <text>]
[--copyright <text>])

commands.name: repl
commands.description:
Start a REPL, or stay in one when --load /
--eval are done. Must come before a script file:
after one it is that script's argument

options.name: --load
options.description: Load a file, then exit (add `repl` to stay)

options.name: --no-init
options.description:
Skip loading the user init file (REPL/--eval/--load)
--readline / --no-readline   Force the line-editing REPL on / off
(default: on when input and output are a
terminal). TERM=dumb turns it off in every
case

options.name: --color
options.description:
Colour the REPL's prompt, values, warnings
and errors: auto (default: only on a
terminal), always or never. NO_COLOR and
TERM=dumb turn it off in every case;
DOTCL_COLORS changes the colours (see
docs/repl.md)

options.name: --completion
options.description:
Emit a shell completion script for
pwsh / bash / zsh / fish

options.name: --asd-search-path
options.description:
Append <dir> to asdf:*central-registry*
after asdf loads (repeatable)
